storyCards.fact:
Christina Perri's "Arms" reached #94 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Arms" is a song written and performed by American singer-songwriter Christina Perri, and was the second single released from her 2011 debut album Lovestrong.

The song peaked at #94 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Arms was released in 2011.
